pricing.details: Free forever — 25 responses to start, or up to a published Stripe MRR of 4,459 € (50 responses/month, 1 collector). Starter 26 €/month or 21 €/month billed annually (246 €/year). Growth 88 €/month or 70 €/month billed annually (845 €/year). Business 267 €/month or 213 €/month billed annually (2,558 €/year). Extra packs: 50 responses 6 €; 300 responses 21 € (100 for 8 € also stated).
